description: Test a storage path template to see how it would resolve for documents. Useful for validating path templates before creating or updating storage paths.

matching_algorithm.description: Matching algorithm: 0=None, 1=Any word, 2=All words, 3=Exact match, 4=Regular expression, 5=Fuzzy word, 6=Automatic

path.description: The path template to test, e.g. '{{ created_year }}/{{ correspondent }}/{{ title }}'

name: test_storage_path
